notes.title: MacOS support is here!
notes.content:
Hey racers,

Big news! Kart Them All is now available on macOS and Linux!

[h2] New Features [/h2]
[list]
    [*] [b]macOS and Linux Support[/b]: Play on your favorite platform!
    [*] [b]Cross-Platform Multiplayer[/b]: Race with friends no matter their system!
[/list]
[h2] Improvements [/h2]
[list]
    [*] Performance optimizations for a smoother gaming experience.
    [*] Bug fixes for better stability.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and have fun!

The Awesome Projection Games Team

notes.title: The game demo is out now!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce that the Kart Them All demo is now available on Steam!
Here's a taste of what you'll find inside:
[list]
[*] 3 fully destructible maps (space, mine and disco) with their own rules
[*] 6 items (with, for example, a freezegun or a repellent magnet)
[*] the ability to play remotely via the Steam network
[*] local play with multiple controllers
[*] the ability to play via Steam Remote Play Together
[*] the ability to play all of these simultaneously
[*] choose from 14 card colors
[*] 3 types of joystick control available
[/list]
And this list will continue to grow.
So... what are you waiting for? Grab a friend, try out the demo and tell us on Discord what you thought!
